title: luscious smoky skillet argentinian beef skillet
description: rich, flaky, one-pot argentinian dish featuring fajita seasoning, smoke, egg-free-friendly, vessel=kadhai

ingredients.name: beef strips (skirt steak or flank steak)
ingredients.notes: preferably a day or two aged

ingredients.name: smoked paprika
ingredients.notes: optional, but recommended for a deeper flavor

ingredients.name: red wine
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a depth of flavor

ingredients.name: tomato paste
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a burst of flavor

ingredients.name: chopped fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a pop of freshness

ingredients.name: black beans, cooked
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds protein and fiber

ingredients.name: crushed red pepper flakes
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a spicy kick

instructions: heat a large kadhai or cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat
add 2 tbsp of oil and swirl to coat the bottom of the pan
add the sliced onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until caramelized
add the sliced bell pepper and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally
add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning
add the beef strips and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned on both sides
add the fajita seasoning blend, smoked paprika, and crushed red pepper flakes (if using) and stir to combine
add the red wine (if using) and beef broth and stir to combine
bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beef is cooked through and the sauce has thickened
stir in the tomato paste (if using) and cook for an additional 2 minutes
season with salt and pepper to taste
serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro (if using)
